# Extraction frontend diagnostic registry

The closed `agent-ix.extraction-frontend.*` set, rendered from
`crates/extraction-frontend/src/diagnostics.rs`. 27 codes.

Every code the frontend emits is one variant of this enum, and the wire
spelling exists only in the enum's `Display`; no module under
`crates/extraction-frontend/src/` names a code as a string literal
(FR-096-AC-3). Severity and blocking are fixed per code, except that
`ENGINE_DIAGNOSTIC` takes the mapped engine severity (`advisory` is
`info`) and blocks if and only if that severity is `error`, and
`ARTIFACT_NOT_LOWERED` is a non-blocking `warning` when the engine
reason is `legacy-form` (FR-096-CON-1).

An engine `semantic.*` code is never emitted as the frontend's own and
never placed in `causes`: `ENGINE_DIAGNOSTIC` opens its message with
`<engine code> (reason: <reason>): <engine message>`. A reader
`agent-ix.semantic-ir.*` code is carried only in `causes[0]` of an
`INVALID_IR`.

| Code | Severity | Blocking | Raised when |
|---|---|---|---|
| `agent-ix.extraction-frontend.MODULE_WITHOUT_SEMANTIC_BLOCK` | error | yes | a supplied module carries no `semantic` block, so nothing can be extracted under it |
| `agent-ix.extraction-frontend.MODULE_REFUSED` | error | yes | the engine refused a supplied module; the engine's `semantic.*` code opens the message |
| `agent-ix.extraction-frontend.BUNDLE_UNIDENTIFIED` | error | yes | `spec/spec.md` is absent or its `org`/`name` is missing or malformed, or an object-typed document has no `id` |
| `agent-ix.extraction-frontend.DUPLICATE_ARTIFACT_ID` | error | yes | two documents of the bundle declare one `id` |
| `agent-ix.extraction-frontend.UNKNOWN_OBJECT_TYPE` | error | yes | a document declares an `object` no supplied module declares |
| `agent-ix.extraction-frontend.UNRESOLVED_TYPE_TOKEN` | error | yes | a `Type` cell names nothing the kernel, the bundle, or the module resolves |
| `agent-ix.extraction-frontend.STALE_TYPE_TOKEN` | error | yes | a `Type` cell resolves to an artifact that produced no definition |
| `agent-ix.extraction-frontend.IMPORT_UNSUPPORTED` | error | yes | a `Type` cell names an artifact of another package; cross-package imports are out of scope |
| `agent-ix.extraction-frontend.KERNEL_NAME_SHADOWED` | warning | no | a bundle artifact's title equals a kernel scalar name |
| `agent-ix.extraction-frontend.UNNAMEABLE_ARTIFACT` | error | yes | an artifact has no title from which a definition name can be taken |
| `agent-ix.extraction-frontend.ARTIFACT_NOT_LOWERED` | warning (`legacy-form`), else error | no (`legacy-form`), else yes | the engine left an artifact's fields unavailable; the availability reason names why |
| `agent-ix.extraction-frontend.DUPLICATE_TYPE_NAME` | error | yes | two artifacts derive one type slug |
| `agent-ix.extraction-frontend.DUPLICATE_IDENTITY` | error | yes | two admitted nodes mint the same semantic identity |
| `agent-ix.extraction-frontend.DUPLICATE_CONSTRAINT` | error | yes | one row carries one constraint keyword twice |
| `agent-ix.extraction-frontend.CONSTRAINT_NOT_APPLICABLE` | error | yes | a constraint keyword does not apply to the resolved type of its row |
| `agent-ix.extraction-frontend.DECLARED_LOSS` | info | no | the frontend dropped a construct the extraction contract declares lossy |
| `agent-ix.extraction-frontend.UNRESOLVED_RELATIONSHIP_TARGET` | error | yes | a frontmatter relationship names a target the bundle index does not resolve |
| `agent-ix.extraction-frontend.UNKNOWN_EDGE_VERB` | error | yes | a frontmatter relationship uses a verb the loaded registry does not define |
| `agent-ix.extraction-frontend.UNSLUGGABLE_NAME` | error | yes | a name derives an empty slug |
| `agent-ix.extraction-frontend.OUTPUT_UNWRITABLE` | error | yes | `--out` lies inside the bundle root or cannot be written |
| `agent-ix.extraction-frontend.LIMIT_MAX_DOCUMENTS` | error | yes | the bundle holds more documents than NFR-031 admits |
| `agent-ix.extraction-frontend.LIMIT_MAX_DOCUMENT_BYTES` | error | yes | one document is larger than NFR-031 admits |
| `agent-ix.extraction-frontend.LIMIT_MAX_FIELDS_PER_RECORD` | error | yes | one record declares more fields than NFR-031 admits |
| `agent-ix.extraction-frontend.LIMIT_MAX_CLAUSE_BYTES` | error | yes | one clause is longer than NFR-031 admits |
| `agent-ix.extraction-frontend.LIMIT_MAX_DEPTH` | error | yes | a nested structure is deeper than NFR-031 admits |
| `agent-ix.extraction-frontend.ENGINE_DIAGNOSTIC` | mapped from the engine | iff the mapped severity is `error` | the engine returned a `SemanticDiagnostic`; its code, reason and message open the frontend's message |
| `agent-ix.extraction-frontend.INVALID_IR` | error | yes | the reader (`agent_ix_semantic_ir::decide`) rejected the lifted document; the reader's diagnostic is `causes[0]` |
